title: Operational Slackline: 90-day burn, headcount phasing & price elasticity projection
content:
Executive summary:

This working sheet is an operational "slackline" for the next 90 days — a short-horizon budget + headcount phasing plan married to a pricing sensitivity sweep. Purpose: give GTM, Product and Eng clear, actionable triggers that preserve runway while protecting feature delivery for prioritized projects. Not final; running assumptions below.

High-level results (quick take):
- Base price: current list; Base hiring plan (Q4 sprint cadence) keeps runway stable to Mar 2027 assuming no >15% demand shock.
- Price -10% scenario: taxable impact reduces gross margin by ~8–10% over 90d; recommended mitigation: pull non-core hires (2 FTEs) into hold and accelerate caching/quantization cost work.
- Price -20% scenario: material margin pressure; require immediate activation of the Tiered Surcharge (temp) + 4-week hiring freeze to avoid runway slip >6 weeks.

Assumptions (explicit):
1) Revenue mix: 60% hosted API, 25% Dedicated, 15% Private (on contracts recognized ratably).
2) Token cost baseline = $0.0008 per infer token (weighted across model mix); improvements from quantization & caching scheduled to reduce realized cost by 8% in 45 days under active Optimize program.
3) Hiring plan: 7 net new roles planned across Eng + SRE + Product over 90 days. Hire phasing assumes 8–10 week average time-to-fill; salary+burden per role averaged at $220k/yr fully-loaded.
4) Burst capacity: reserve GPU pool (spot + reserved combination) sized to cover 12% peak delta; incremental cost applied to ops in scenario simulations.
5) Sticky customers: top 10 customers represent 42% of hosted ARR; sensitivity tests include a top-customer churn event (loss of 1 of top-10 = ~7% ARR).

Sheet layout / key tabs (described as table extracts):

A) Headcount phasing (planned hires vs recommended hold) — 90-day window
Date range: Nov 2026 — Jan 2027
Columns: Role | Team | Proposed start | Recruit ROI weeks | Monthly cost (fully loaded) | Recommended action
Rows:
- Staff SWE | eng-serving-runtime | 2026-11-15 | 8 | $18,333 | proceed
- Site Reliability Eng | eng-sre | 2026-12-01 | 10 | $19,500 | proceed (contingent on pricing outcome)
- Product Manager (Optimize) | product-optimize | 2026-11-22 | 9 | $14,800 | proceed
- Solutions Engineer | solutions | 2026-12-10 | 6 | $13,900 | hold if price -20%
- Quant Engineer | applied-ml | 2026-12-05 | 12 | $17,500 | accelerate if price -10% (cost savings lever)
- Customer Success (mid-market) | customer-success | 2027-01-03 | 8 | $11,200 | proceed (but delay onboarding budget)
- Payroll contractor (ops) | finance | 2026-11-20 | 4 | $6,000 | short-term contract only

B) 90-day cost and runway projection (summary rows, monthly cadence):
Cols: Scenario | Starting runway (weeks) | Cash burn/mo | Net headcount add cost/mo | Adjusted runway (weeks)
- Base | 62 | $6.2M | $0.95M | 62
- Price -10% | 62 | $6.78M | $0.95M | 56
- Price -20% | 62 | $7.36M | $0.95M | 50
- Price -10% + quant accelerate | 62 | $6.38M | $1.02M (accelerated hires offset) | 60
Notes: runway numbers reflect conservative cash flow recognition and exclude committed Dedicated contract deposits.

C) Pricing sensitivity matrix (elasticity sweep — unit economics):
Columns: Price change | Demand delta assumption | Token margin change | Net revenue impact (90d) | Recommended mitigation
Rows:
- +5% price | -2% demand | +4% margin | +$420k | no action
- 0% price (base) | 0% demand | 0 | baseline | monitor
- -10% price | +3% demand or -5% (two cases) | -8% margin | -$1.1M (if demand flat) | accelerate caching + pause 2 hires
- -20% price | +8% demand / -10% demand (two cases) | -18% margin | -$2.3M (if demand flat) | implement surcharge, hiring freeze, quick-contract reductions

D) Action wiring and triggers (operational playbook snippets):
Trigger 1 (Price move -10% observed for >10 days): pause non-critical hiring 1–2 roles, deploy Optimize quantization sprint (2wk), push tiered surcharge to enterprise customers for new usage.
Trigger 2 (Runway drops under 48 weeks): freeze all non-essential hiring, open emergency cost review with Eng leads, identify 3% non-labor cost cuts.
Trigger 3 (Top 10 customer churn >5% ARR instant loss): prioritize contract rescue (discount + 90-day credits) and execute a 4-week upper-management contingency hiring hold.

E) MVP knobs and estimated impact (quick levers for Finance/Eng):
- Knob: accelerate quantization rollouts — est. cost savings 5–12% on token compute within 45 days if full-time quant engineer is onboarded and paired with runtime team.
- Knob: increase caching TTL (prefix+kv) on high-frequency routes — est. 3–6% token saving in 30 days; low engineering cost.
- Knob: temporary enterprise surcharge (volume-based) — tactical preservation of net margin while public pricing remains unchanged.
- Knob: reduce free-tier credits for new signups for 30 days — expected to reduce low-value churn/noise and save $80–120k/month in token cost.

F) Open questions / notes to self (work-in-progress):
- Confirm exact contract recognition timing for 3 in-flight Dedicated deals (affects Nov cash by ~$450k).
- Validate hire time-to-productivity assumptions for quant role with Applied ML (Liam).
- Build a small simulation harness to run stochastic assortment of demand shocks (Monte Carlo) — assign to finance data engineer (ticket: JIRA-PLAN-3221).
- Check gating language for Tiered Surcharge (Legal redlines needed).

Appendix (mini table: sensitivity for top-10 customers)
Columns: Customer | % ARR | Likely elasticity | Contingency
- CustA | 11% | low elasticity (enterprise SLA) | account health playbook
- CustB | 6% | medium | upsell to Dedicated offering
- CustC | 5% | high (price sensitive) | consider promotional commit

Quick next steps (this week):
- Finance to run exact cash-flow sheet with updated Dedicated deposits (Anika) — due Nov 12.
- Eng + Applied ML to estimate 2-week quant sprint deliverables and gating (Liam, Ethan) — due Nov 15.
- GTM to draft Tiered Surcharge email/contract language (Maya) — initial draft Nov 13.

Version notes: working doc v0.1 — intentionally terse, intended for rapid iteration in Drive. Use this as canonical 90-day operational buffer model until v0.3 when Monte Carlo harness is integrated.
